title.narrative: Resilient Economies and Sustainable Livelihoods for Empowerment in Yemen (RESOLVE)

description.narrative: Resilient Economies and Sustainable Livelihoods for Empowerment in Yemen aims to strengthen the resilience and economic empowerment of vulnerable communities in the Marib and Hadramout (Valley) governorates by supporting the creation, growth, and long-term sustainability of agribusinesses and agricultural value chains. In response to Yemen’s protracted conflict, economic collapse, and severe food insecurity, the project shifts from short-term humanitarian assistance toward integrated, resilience-based development. It promotes climate-smart agriculture, value chain upgrading, and agribusiness development; improves access to finance through revolving funds and microfinance; and strengthens the local business enabling environment by enhancing coordination between local authorities, chambers of commerce, financial institutions, and the private sector. Special emphasis is placed on inclusive, gender-sensitive livelihood opportunities that target women, youth, internally displaced persons, marginalized groups, and people with disabilities. As part of a broader USD 19.5–19.6 million multi-donor RESOLVE programme, the project aligns with the Humanitarian–Development–Peace Nexus, national development priorities, and SDGs 1, 2, and 8 to contribute to sustainable food security, decent work, and economic recovery in Yemen.
